biggest_catch: You must be a pregnant woman 18-45 at 8-18 gestational weeks, English speaking, with BMI 20-45, and the study requires daily self-monitoring for ~29 weeks; not everyone qualifies.
catches: Must be pregnant, 18-45 years old, 8-18 gestational weeks at enrollment, English speaking, BMI 20-45.
Requires daily self-weighing, wearing an activity monitor, and completing surveys over ~29 weeks of gestation.
Random assignment to intervention or attention-control group.
$250 total for a long participation period.

steps: Find the Healthy Mom Zone study on the Penn State Study Finder.
Complete a pre-intervention session explaining study procedures.
Follow the assigned intervention or control routine from ~8 to ~37 weeks gestation: daily self-weighing, activity monitor, surveys.
Attend a post-intervention session, return devices, complete a 30-60 minute interview and final surveys.
timing: ~8 to ~37 weeks gestation: 1 pre-intervention session, daily self-monitoring, 1 post-intervention session with interview.
